title: Elastic Agent host CPU
description: CPU of the Elastic Agent hosts, the 90 percent line, and the processes behind the spike.

data_source.query: FROM metrics-system.cpu-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 1 | EVAL cpu = ROUND(system.cpu.total.norm.pct * 100, 1) | KEEP cpu
FROM metrics-system.cpu-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS cpu = ROUND(MAX(system.cpu.total.norm.pct) * 100, 1)

FROM metrics-system.process-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND process.cpu.pct IS NOT NULL | STATS sample_cpu = SUM(process.cpu.pct) BY process.name, @timestamp | STATS cpu = MAX(sample_cpu) BY process.name | SORT cpu DESC | LIMIT 1 | KEEP process.name
FROM metrics-system.cpu-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS cpu = ROUND(MAX(system.cpu.total.norm.pct) * 100, 1) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), host.name
FROM metrics-system.cpu-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS samples = COUNT() BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL alert_line = 90

FROM metrics-system.process-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND process.cpu.pct IS NOT NULL | STATS sample_cpu = SUM(process.cpu.pct) BY process.name, @timestamp | STATS cpu = ROUND(MAX(sample_cpu) * 100, 1) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 40, ?_tstart, ?_tend), process.name | WHERE cpu >= 5

FROM metrics-system.process-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND process.cpu.pct IS NOT NULL | STATS sample_cpu = SUM(process.cpu.pct) BY process.name, @timestamp | STATS cpu = ROUND(MAX(sample_cpu) * 100, 1) BY process.name | SORT cpu DESC | LIMIT 8

FROM metrics-system.process-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND process.cpu.pct IS NOT NULL | STATS sample_cpu = SUM(process.cpu.pct) BY host.name, process.name, @timestamp | STATS cpu = ROUND(MAX(sample_cpu) * 100, 1), samples = COUNT(*) BY host.name, process.name | WHERE cpu >= 1 | SORT cpu DESC | LIMIT 12
